basic_profile.bio: A digital marketing specialist from Portland, Oregon, NeoNetrunner2025 has a keen interest in cyberpunk culture and dystopian narratives. They enjoy discussing the latest developments in video games and virtual reality, while also exploring the intersection of technology and society. When not online, they can be found hiking in the Pacific Northwest or attending local music gigs. Their typical online hours are late evenings, often after 9 PM. Currently in a relationship, they spend weekends exploring new cafes and bookstores with their partner.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: NeoNetrunner2025 holds a degree in Communications and has worked in digital advertising for over five years. Their expertise is further enriched by a personal passion for gaming and tech, which they have pursued through self-study and community engagement on platforms like Reddit.
